STEP 1 - Scene: A mixed green salad (mesclun-style leaves: red leaf lettuce, oak/green leaf, spinach-like and arugula-like leaves) in a bowl. No dressing is visible.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white bowl, roughly 22-24 cm across (between side plate and dinner plate). Taking 23 cm: area = 3.14 x (11.5)^2 ≈ 415 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: mixed salad greens only (no dressing, oil, or protein visible).

STEP 4 - Area: the leaves fill most of the bowl, about 85% of the vessel area (~350 cm^2).

STEP 5 - Volume: the pile is loose and piled up, with an average height of about 3 cm: 350 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 1050 ml gross.

STEP 6 - Grams: loose leafy greens at about 0.15 g/ml: 1050 ml x 0.15 ≈ 158 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: mixed salad leaves ≈ 20 kcal per 100 g: 158 g x 0.20 ≈ 32 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: a bowl of loosely heaped mixed greens weighing about 150 g and about 30 kcal is plausible. Greens are very low in energy, so the total stays small even if the weight is off somewhat.
